Two components in the patient chart use `UserIcon`, both as the trigger icon for an "orderer" tooltip. Both import it from `@openmrs/esm-framework`, which exposes the core definition. If `UserIcon` changed its rendering, props, or ref behaviour, these two are affected. I found no other `UserIcon` uses in the chart, and no chart tests reference it.

1. **Medications details table**: `InfoTooltip` (line 376) wraps `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside an `IconButton` with the orderer name as its label. It is rendered at line 204 with `medication.orderer?.person?.display`. The import is at line 48.
2. **Medication record (orders app)**: `InfoTooltip` (line 105) wraps `<UserIcon size={16} />` inside a `ToggletipButton` that shows the orderer in a `Toggletip`. It is rendered at line 27 with `order.orderer?.display`. The import is at line 5.

The core definition is `UserIcon` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` (line 824), a `memo(forwardRef(...))` component. The core mocks at `esm-styleguide/mock.tsx` (line 99) and `mock-jest.tsx` (line 98) stub it as a `<span>`, so chart tests that use those mocks would see the stub, not the real icon.
